captions.detailed: A commercial-grade adjustable workout bench featuring a heavy-duty welded black metal frame, a split pad layout (backrest and seat), and a front foot-roller assembly. The rear base includes small transport wheels, while the front end rests on a wide cross-member support. The backrest and seat pads pivot on separate transverse hinges, the rear support arm rotates on a lower frame pivot, and both the transport wheels and the front foot rollers spin continuously on their axles.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a commercial adjustable gym bench using CadQuery. The model must feature a split-pad layout (backrest and seat), a welded black metal frame with transport wheels at the rear, and a dual-roller foot assembly at the front. Ensure the backrest and seat can pivot on hinges, the rear support arm can rotate on a frame pivot, and both the wheels and front rollers spin continuously.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first building a base frame ('base_link') using box and cylinder primitives for the cross-beams, wheel brackets, and axles. It defines separate parts for the backrest, seat, rear support arm, transport wheels, and front rollers. Revolute joints are implemented to allow the backrest and seat to pivot relative to the frame, while continuous joints are used for the spinning transport wheels and the dual front rollers on their shared axle.
